title: Open world driver super alpha
author: lowdragmafia
selftext: Hey guys. Here's a little glance at the highway racer city sim I'm designing. I have always had a passion with AI games and since my last break to now I am having so much more fun then ever slowly updating and chipping away at something that may interest someone else besides me. That being said I'm using opus and fable (claude) and also utilizing free assets online. On the other hand I'm utilizing MUSE for suggestions and live hosting. Game is early on. I want to know what should be added. Should I make the world fully destructible?
